column1: # nativeps5 Metal shader keys: GRAPHICS (vertex + fragment) pairs that use our own Metal translation (Kyty MSL back end) instead of KosmicKrisp's.
# HASHES AND SMALL NUMBERS ONLY, no shader code. Row: gfx vs_digest vs_spec ps_digest ps_spec kk_vs kk_fs sha256_vs sha256_fs variant set0 va colour_mask evidence.
# set0 = descriptor offsets binding:offset, va = vertex attributes loc:binding:fmt. KosmicKrisp swaps a pair only when BOTH kk keys match. Fast-math OFF keys.
# v1.1: NO verified pairs yet. Empty list = KosmicKrisp builds every graphics pipeline itself (the generator path stays).
